docs-mcp-server scrape <library> <url> [options]

Scrape and index documentation from a URL or local folder.

To scrape local files or folders, use a file:// URL.
Examples:
scrape mylib https://react.dev/reference/react
scrape mylib file:///Users/me/docs/index.html
scrape mylib file:///Users/me/docs/my-library

Note: For local files/folders, you must use the file:// prefix. If running in
Docker, mount the folder and use the container path. See README for details.

Позиционные аргументы:
  library  Library name                             [строковой тип] [необходимо]
  url      URL or file:// path to scrape            [строковой тип] [необходимо]

Опции:
  -h, --help                                Показать помощь        [булевый тип]
      --output                              Structured output format for
                                            commands that return data
                           [строковой тип] [возможности: "json", "yaml", "toon"]
      --verbose                             Enable verbose (debug) logging
                                             [булевый тип] [по умолчанию: false]
      --quiet, --silent                     Disable all logging except errors
                                             [булевый тип] [по умолчанию: false]
      --telemetry                           Enable/disable telemetry collection
                                                                   [булевый тип]
      --store-path, --storePath             Custom path for data storage
                                            directory            [строковой тип]
      --config                              Path to configuration file
                                                                 [строковой тип]
      --logo                                Show ASCII art logo on startup
                                              [булевый тип] [по умолчанию: true]
  -v, --version                             Version of the library (optional)
                                                                 [строковой тип]
  -p, --max-pages, --maxPages               Maximum pages to scrape      [число]
  -d, --max-depth, --maxDepth               Maximum navigation depth     [число]
  -c, --max-concurrency, --maxConcurrency   Maximum concurrent page requests
                                                                         [число]
      --ignore-errors, --ignoreErrors       Ignore errors during scraping
                                              [булевый тип] [по умолчанию: true]
      --scope                               Crawling boundary
      [возможности: "subpages", "hostname", "domain"] [по умолчанию: "subpages"]
      --follow-redirects,                   Follow HTTP redirects
      --followRedirects                       [булевый тип] [по умолчанию: true]
      --scrape-mode, --scrapeMode           HTML processing strategy
             [возможности: "fetch", "playwright", "auto"] [по умолчанию: "auto"]
      --preserve-hashes, --preserveHashes   Preserve URL hash fragments for
                                            hash-routed SPA documentation sites
                                                                   [булевый тип]
      --include-pattern, --includePattern   Glob or regex pattern for URLs to
                                            include (can be specified multiple
                                            times). Regex patterns must be
                                            wrapped in slashes, e.g. /pattern/.
                                                     [массив] [по умолчанию: []]
      --exclude-pattern, --excludePattern   Glob or regex pattern for URLs to
                                            exclude (can be specified multiple
                                            times, takes precedence over
                                            include). Regex patterns must be
                                            wrapped in slashes, e.g. /pattern/.
                                                     [массив] [по умолчанию: []]
      --header                              Custom HTTP header to send with each
                                            request (can be specified multiple
                                            times)   [массив] [по умолчанию: []]
      --embedding-model, --embeddingModel   Embedding model configuration (e.g.,
                                            'openai:text-embedding-3-small')
                                                                 [строковой тип]
      --server-url, --serverUrl             URL of external pipeline worker RPC
                                            (e.g., http://localhost:8080/api)
                                                                 [строковой тип]
      --clean                               Clear existing documents before
                                            scraping
                                              [булевый тип] [по умолчанию: true]
